steps.title: The mill yard
steps.content: Talk to Elsa Rook. She knows why the mill has been burning.

steps.title: The ash path
steps.content: The door east of the mill yard leads to the ash path and the Ember Vault.

steps.title: Encounters
steps.content: Maps with a curated encounter list show the fight panel in the context pane.

steps.title: Turns
steps.content: Combat unfolds in turns. Attack, defend, take cover or use a potion.

steps.title: Conditions
steps.content: Some enemies inflict conditions. Use the escape action or stand up when offered.

steps.title: Abilities
steps.content: Class abilities consume mana and are listed in the context pane.

steps.title: Talking
steps.content: Talk to NPCs and choose the quest option. Quests appear in the quest log.

steps.title: Turn in
steps.content: Return to the NPC named in the quest when the objective is complete.
